title.narrative: BlueOrchard Covid 19 Emerging & Frontier Markets MSME Support Fund

description.narrative: Blue Orchard Emerging Markets MSME liquidity facility was conceived out of the liquidity and solvency challenges faced by strong microfinance institutions (“MFIs”) because of the Covid-19 crisis.

• Support selected financial institutions (“FIs”) in emerging and frontier markets, through the provision of liquidity to cope with the impact of Covid-19 on their operations and portfolios. • Ensure that FIs pursue on-lending support to their MSME clients so that they can benefit directly from the liquidity provided by the Fund. • Enable MSMEs remain operational across sectors and allow entrepreneurs and employees to maintain their jobs and have access to financial and non-financial support during and after the Covid-19 crisis.

activity-date.narrative: The exit will be in 2027 with the option to extend subject to majority vote by the LPAC. Further, FSDAi’s investment will be recovered at the end of the Fund and the NAV will be determined in accordance with the Luxembourg Law, the Partnership Agreement, and the Lux GAAP.

recipient-region.narrative: FSDAi’s investment is ring-fenced to SSA
